extra.message: Hardcoded/weak session secret — Complete authentication bypass: an attacker can craft arbitrary session tokens, log in as any user (including admin), and access all application functionality and data. [verified: Default session_secret 'dev-only-change-me' is weak and if not overridden via environment variable, an attacker can trivially forge valid session cookies via itsdangerous URLSafeSerializer to impersonate any user. No compensating controls (e.g., strength checks, mandatory env override enforcement, or additional cryptographic hardening) are present.]

Path traversal in /ops/parcel allows arbitrary file read — An attacker with valid internal ops token can read any file on the filesystem that the application process can read, potentially leaking sensitive data (SSN, financial records, config). [verified: Line 30 concatenates user-controlled packet_ref with BASE_EXPORT_DIR via Path division, allowing path traversal sequences like '../' to read arbitrary files at line 32. The _wrk_gate auth check does not sanitize the path, so an attacker with a valid token can read any file the process can access.]
